title: Enjoying the new F70 and automatic drive
summary: This topic is mainly about owners saying they are enjoying their new F70, especially the driving experience and, in one case, the automatic transmission, with a small amount of disappointment and a few date or app-status mentions that do not clearly express sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say owners are really enjoying the new car and its driving experience, including appreciation of the automatic gearbox.

negative.summary: The negative review expresses disappointment with a latest 120i M Sport but does not provide enough detail about the specific problem in this fragment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention an April delivery date and an app mileage display issue reappearing, but they do not clearly state an overall sentiment toward the car.

limitations: Many fragments are very short expressions of enjoyment and provide limited detail about specific vehicle attributes.
